title: valerianella grayi
intro: Valerianella grayi, commonly known as the creeping valerian or gray's cornsalad, is a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is a low-growing, edible herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary properties. Valerianella grayi is known to have several health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
